Name: Attai, Son of Jarha
Summary: Son of Jarha by Sheshan's daughter, and father of Nathan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:35: Son of Jarha by Sheshan's daughter, and father of Nathan.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Attai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
